notes: This contract records portable C++ TCK checks for standard HLAreportServiceInvocation delivery when public federate, object-class, interaction-class, parameter, object-instance, attribute, and update-rate lookup services are invoked with both valid and invalid inputs. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM data elements, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, application FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. It verifies typed supplied and returned argument records, service classification, reliable delivery metadata, success and failure state, standard exception classes, Null returns, and serial progression. Provider-private headers, registries, file sinks, names, and diagnostics are outside this contract.
